_comment_user: Who D.A.V.E. is working for. address_as is what he calls you — 'sir', your first name, or "" for none.
_comment_personality: wit: dry | light | off. pushback: firm | gentle | off. See references/persona.md.
_comment_redmine: authority: read-only | propose-writes | auto-routine. 'propose-writes' means D.A.V.E. actively drafts ticket updates and time logs but never sends one without a yes.
_comment_kanban: Boards are pasted or screenshotted in by hand — D.A.V.E. has no API to them. List them so he knows what he is missing when one goes stale.
_comment_priorities: max_now caps how many things may sit in the Now section. drift_threshold_minutes is how long unlisted work runs before D.A.V.E. says something.
_comment_hooks: session_start injects your current focus and Now list as context at the start of every Claude Code session. Set false to make D.A.V.E. speak only when invoked.
_comment_roster: Which specialist agents D.A.V.E. may delegate to. Remove any you don't want him reaching for.
